name: Introduction and overview — E-6 Mercury — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — E-6 Mercury
description: Introduction and overview of the E-6 Mercury: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The E-6 Mercury is a four-engine airborne command post built by Boeing on the 707 airframe, entering service in 1989. In the TACAMO role it trails a miles-long antenna to communicate with ballistic-missile submarines, providing survivable nuclear command and control. 16 were built. Baseline facts: Airborne nuclear command post; service from 1989; 16 built on Boeing 707 airframes; TACAMO role..
